rows.text: 39）。这就是说，当电容器开始
充电的时刻，电流强度是最大
值，而电压等于零。此后，电压
达到最大值时，电流强度变为
零，依此类推。
电流强度的振幅等于
I_{[m-shaped amplitude glyph]}=U_{[m-shaped amplitude glyph]}ωC
如果引入符号
1/(ωC)=X_{[closed oval subscript o/0, not an assured c]}
并用电流强度和电压的有效值代替它们的振幅，则得出：
I=U/X_c
■ X_C，即电容器的电容和角频率的乘积的倒数，叫做容抗。
rows.note: Capital/open C-shaped subscript visually larger in this bold line; exact case is to be compared rather than inferred.

电流强度与电压的关系一样遵循欧姆定律，也就是可以把量
X_c看作电容器对交流电的阻抗（容抗）。
根据公式（2.26），电容器的电容越大，电容器反复充电的
电流越大。这一点从电容器电容增大时灯泡的白炽程度增加
可以很容易看出来。
电容器对直流电的电阻是无限大，同时它对交流电的阻
抗具有有限值X_{[open round subscript]}。随着电容增大，阻抗减小；随着频率增大，

objects: A vertical axis extending above and below a horizontal axis, with an upward arrowhead.
A horizontal time axis extending slightly left of the vertical axis and rightward to an arrowhead.
Two continuous wave-like curves, one thick and one thinner.
Thin curve starts positive at the vertical axis, decreases across the horizontal axis to a later trough, then rises across the axis to a later positive peak and descends again.
Thick curve starts at/slightly below the axes intersection, descends to an earlier trough, rises across the horizontal axis to an earlier positive peak, then crosses downward and ends negative.
Two small separate leader arrows: i_C(t) points down-right to the thick rising curve before its positive crest; u_C(t) points down-right to the thinner rising curve before its later crest.
Two curve intersections are visible: near negative y at left and near positive y at right.
A round italic origin glyph is left/below the axis crossing.
i_C and u_C label the vertical-axis quantities; t labels the right end of the horizontal axis.
relationships: Printed i_C(t) leader attaches to the thick curve, not the thin curve.
Printed u_C(t) leader attaches to the thin curve, not the thick curve.
The thick curve's trough and crest occur leftward of the thin curve's trough and crest.
No scientific correction, phase reinterpretation, label swap, artificial ticks or regularized curve data is authorized.
